context: The Advanced Market Chart consumed excessive space while historical data remained secondary, and the latest deposit/withdrawal receipt cards displayed bare dash placeholders when no wallet/receipt data was available. The user requested a collapsed chart and intentional animated empty receipt states with a prominent route back to wallet connection.

behavior: Advanced market context is opt-in instead of permanently consuming screen height.
Native details/summary progressive disclosure is used.
The outer chart workspace no longer uses max-height plus overflow:auto; when opened, the card grows naturally and the page scrolls.
Liquidity manager return link remains available.

receipt_cards.rule: Never expose bare dash placeholders as the primary empty state.
behavior: When no verified receipt exists, amount rows and receipt tools are hidden.
A larger intentional empty state becomes the dominant card content.
Subtle XRBC/XRP flow motion is shown but does not imply ledger execution.
Status copy distinguishes wallet-required from wallet-inspected/no-saved-receipt.
A large Connect / inspect wallet action jumps to #walletHeading.
When a verified receipt exists, the empty state disappears and actual receipt amounts/tools are shown.

visual_motion_policy: Use subtle motion only to make an otherwise empty state feel intentional and discoverable.
Motion must not imply that a transaction, payment, or ledger change is occurring.
Use real data when available; never insert fake sample values or zeros to fill an empty card.
project_wide_ux_rule: Low-priority or uncertain secondary analytics should default to progressive disclosure rather than permanent screen real estate.
Wallet/account-dependent empty cards should present a designed state plus a clear next action instead of dashes, fake values or ambiguous blank metrics.
The most relevant recovery/navigation action should be visually dominant in the empty state.
safety_invariants: No intended changes to Xaman authorization, reconnect behavior or wallet identity.
No intended changes to AMM deposit/withdraw, trade, trustline, signing, submission or validated-finality logic.
No intended changes to the backend-routed historical market-data architecture.
Receipt data is shown only when a verified receipt exists.
manual_follow_up: Hard-refresh the Liquidity Pool and verify the Advanced Market Chart is compact when closed and has no nested scroll trap when open.
Verify disconnected receipt cards show movement + large wallet CTA and no visible dash amounts.
Connect a wallet with no saved receipt and confirm the empty-state copy changes appropriately.
Load a verified receipt and confirm real receipt content replaces the empty state.
